primary_anchor_zh: 大窗前的画架、画架左侧木凳和后墙长柜所构成的整体布局
story_reason_zh: 画室木门为遮挡海风而缓慢关闭，随后重新打开

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 整间海边画室在珍珠色海光中的画室，保持安静稳定，仅窗边薄帘轻微移动。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 保持安静稳定，仅窗边薄帘轻微移动
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 大窗前的画架、画架左侧木凳和后墙长柜所构成的整体布局占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 宽大的画室木门缓慢关闭并遮住室内，画面只留下空石露台
shot_design.main_action_zh: 宽大的画室木门缓慢关闭并遮住室内，画面只留下空石露台
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 门、屏风或入口帘的开合符合场景用途，动作缓慢，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 画室木门缓慢打开，重新露出完整海边画室布局
shot_design.main_action_zh: 画室木门缓慢打开，重新露出完整海边画室布局
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新展示大窗前的画架、画架左侧木凳和后墙长柜所构成的整体布局，以整体空间关系作为唯一验收目标。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a large easel before the broad sea-facing window, a wooden stool to the left of the easel, and a long cabinet against the rear wall inside a pearl-lit coastal studio. A thin curtain beside the window moves gently.

A fixed wide shot looks through an open entrance onto a large easel before the broad sea-facing window, a wooden stool to the left of the easel, and a long cabinet against the rear wall inside a pearl-lit coastal studio. A broad wooden studio door slowly closes across the entrance until the room is fully hidden, leaving only the empty stone terrace in view.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty stone terrace. A broad wooden studio door slowly opens, revealing a large easel before the broad sea-facing window, a wooden stool to the left of the easel, and a long cabinet against the rear wall inside a pearl-lit coastal studio.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 宽大的画室木门缓慢关闭并遮住室内，画面只留下空石露台
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 画室木门缓慢打开，重新露出完整海边画室布局
transition_design.design_note_zh: Scene/layout 无法自行离场，因此 Shot 2 用自然遮挡结构缓慢关闭，Shot 3 用对应开启动作重新露出整体布局。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
